new_jobs.title: [L'OREAL Taiwan] Revenue Growth Management Manager
new_jobs.jd: **【A Day in the Life** **】** As Revenue Growth Management Manager for L'Oréal Luxe, you turn complex data into commercial strategies that drive profitable, sustainable market share across our prestige portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), you steer cross-functional alignment across finance, marketing, and commercial teams to unlock growth in Online and Offline (O+O) channels. * Strategy & Governance: Drive local RGM strategy and priority initiatives in line with Zone guidelines, establishing clear KPIs, actionable execution plans, and long-term revenue roadmaps. * Methodological Support & Trade Investment: Provide cross-functional teams with methodological support on channel P&L analysis, formulating strategies for trade investments (discounts, rebates, and terms) to steer high-impact O+O negotiations. * Promotion Optimisation: Identify market-level RGM opportunities and lead promotion optimisation analysis, evaluating seasonality, consumer demand, and competitor elasticity to elevate promotional ROI. * Pricing & Valorisation Management: Steer category pricing architecture and valorisation management across channels, balancing unit, value, and product mix to protect margin health and inventory turnover. * Productivity & Advanced Reporting: Conduct channel productivity analyses and lead SDDS and Business Review (BR) reporting support, leveraging RGM dashboards and the value tracker to feed commercial learnings directly into business units. **【We Are Looking For** **】** You bring analytical precision and commercial acumen to turn complex data into actionable business growth. You bring: * Revenue Growth Management: Advanced expertise in pricing architecture, promotional mechanics, valorisation management (unit/value/mix), and gross-to-net optimisation. * Commercial & P&L Acumen: Deep understanding of channel P&L dynamics, channel productivity, retailer economics, and trade terms (discounts and rebates) across luxury O+O retail. * Data Analytics & Reporting: Proven capability leveraging SDDS, Business Review (BR) tools, and RGM dashboards to build commercial models and steer decision-making. * Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong ability to collaborate with and challenge sales, marketing, and finance counterparts, translating analytics into aligned commercial negotiation toolkits. * Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, with the executive presence to present data-driven strategic narratives to senior management. **【What's In It For You** **】** * A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you'll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!) * Real responsibility from day 1, there's no sitting on the sidelines at L'Oréal * An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!

new_jobs.title: 招募 AI 領導人才｜一起打造 AI Native 的知識媒體集團
new_jobs.jd: 如何結合數十年累積的內容、品牌信任與專家資源，運用 AI 與 AI Agent，開創媒體、出版與學習的新可能？ 遠見天下文化事業群，始終相信進步觀念的力量。我們旗下擁有《遠見》、天下文化、《哈佛商業評論》全球繁體中文版、領導影響力學院、50+、未來親子等品牌，持續以值得信賴的內容與服務，陪伴個人與組織成長。 我們正在尋找兼具技術實力、商業思維與領導潛力的夥伴，共同推動： \* AI 與數據整合：串接內容、會員、客戶資料與既有系統，建立跨品牌共用能力。 \* AI Agent 開發與應用：整合知識庫、工具與工作流程，提升內容、行銷、讀者服務與企業學習的價值。 \* 跨部門專案落地：從需求釐清、MVP 驗證到正式上線，創造可衡量的成果。 \* AI Native 轉型：培養團隊能力，探索新產品、服務與商業模式。 我們期待你 具備 LLM、AI Agent 或相關系統整合實作經驗，能親自動手、帶領跨部門合作，理解使用者需求與商業價值，並重視內容品質與信任。 加分條件 具備資訊系統與技術架構背景，曾將 AI Agent 與企業系統整合，熟悉 API 串接、資料權限與監控；有從原型到正式上線的經驗，能兼顧資安、品質、成本與擴充性。 不限特定職稱，我們更在意你做過什麼、解決過什麼問題，以及實際成果。 歡迎私訊分享作品與想法，也歡迎推薦人才。

new_jobs.title: AI Application Engineer
new_jobs.jd: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Google welcomes people with disabilities. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Taipei, Taiwan; Zhubei, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan** . **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development and engineering. * Experience coding in one or more general-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python and C++). * Experience with Machine Learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX). * Experience implementing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models and pipelines in production environments. **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Experience with multimedia applications, video processing, or computer vision ML tasks. * Experience building and scaling ML pipelines on cloud infrastructure (e.g., Google Cloud Platform) and deploying optimized models to edge devices (e.g., mobile, embedded systems). * Experience with model optimization techniques for performance and latency reduction (e.g., quantization, pruning, hardware-aware tuning). * Familiarity with AI agent architectures, large language models (LLMs), or orchestration systems (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen). * Strong understanding of distributed systems, system architecture, and toolchain development for engineering teams. **About the job** Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology. **Responsibilities** * Design and develop toolchains to support and accelerate multimedia AI activities. * Develop specialized AI agents and orchestration architectures to work together seamlessly on complex goals. * Implement, deploy, and scale multimedia Machine Learning (ML) pipelines across Google Cloud and edge devices. * Optimize machine learning models for improved performance, latency, and deployment efficiency. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Management Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **Job Summary** Supplier professional focused on the strategic leadership and relationship of company suppliers to achieve the best financial performance and relationship with assigned product lines **Principal Responsibilities** * Directs and manages the supplier business plan and implementation process throughout the organization leveraging supplier strengths and resources on behalf of the supplier and communicating supplier benefits to the company. * Aligns goals and objectives of supplier with the company to ensure mutual goals and objectives are achieved. * Determines, monitors and recommends plans for the supplier, company business relationship on a tactical and strategic level. * Participates in supplier business reviews providing appropriate data and engaging in resolving issues. * Identifies and drives new supplier opportunities with particular emphasis on the development of new services that blend unique supplier resource/capability along with service/capability to create a unique value proposition. * Supports cross functional communication with the company's product groups in price negotiations and market knowledge. * Responsible for the management of activities and programs that will drive the supplier’s pro-forma performance in an effort to achieve Avnet's financial goals. * Performs analysis and reports of various program impact for the supplier. * Manages forecasting pipeline requirements and rebate projections. * Other duties as assigned. **Job Level Specifications** * Extensive knowledge and application of principles, theories and concepts. Complete knowledge of all job functions and the broad industry best practices, techniques and standards. * Develops solutions to complex problems where analysis of situations and/or data requires in-depth evaluation of variables. Determine best approach to achieve results and provide suggestions to improve policies and procedures. * Work is performed independently and requires the exercise of judgment and discretion. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. Work may be reviewed at a high-level. * May represent the organization as a primary contact on assignments and/or projects. Interacts with senior professionals and management and frequently coordinates work between departments or organizations. * Actions may impact the organization. Failure to accomplish work will result in the inability to reach crucial organizational goals. Erroneous decisions may have a prolonged effect resulting in the expenditure of substantial resources. **Work Experience** * Typically 5+ years with bachelor's or equivalent. **Education And Certification(s)** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained. **Distinguishing Characteristics** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

new_jobs.title: 【TW Life】Manager, Direct Marketing Strategy Dept.
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** **職務角色：** 負責既有保戶經營策略規劃與執行，透過數據分析與名單優化，提升電銷效益、名單分配效率及業績成長動能，並協同業務單位推動年度經營目標達成。 **主要工作職責：** * 建立並優化既有保戶電銷名單模型，提升名單精準度與轉換效率 * 規劃並持續測試銷售人員人才發展計畫，強化團隊銷售能力 * 規劃滿期活動及相關推廣活動，提升既有保戶經營成效 * 與業務單位合作進行績效追蹤與成效分析，提出改善建議 * 進行新年度業績預估與目標規劃，支援經營決策 * 負責每月名單安排與分配，確保資源運用最佳化 **Qualifications** * 具既有保戶管理、電銷經營、名單策略或業務管理相關經驗 * 熟悉數據分析、名單分配邏輯與業績追蹤作業 * 具跨部門溝通協調能力，能有效推動業務合作 * 具策略思維與問題解決能力，能獨立規劃並執行專案 * 對人才發展、活動規劃及業績成長具高度熱忱 * 具保險、金融或電銷相關產業經驗者尤佳 **招募流程提醒** * 後續面試安排將由本公司海外 Service Hub 透過 Email 進行聯繫，包含面試時間確認與面試邀約寄送。 * 此階段恕無法以電話方式聯繫，敬請留意電子郵件（含垃圾郵件匣），以免錯過重要通知。 **了解更多關於** **Chubb Life Taiwan** **的企業文化與工作環境** * [開箱影片] 走進我們的辦公室，認識工作環境、福利與文化 * [Podcast] 探索我們如何打造支持成長與創新的職場
